item.title: ICE agent shoots and wounds man in Austin, Texas
item.description: The lawyer for the man identified him as a 28-year-old Venezuelan national, Wilber Rafael Garces Perez. Officials said he was shot at least once in the torso and was in serious but stable condition.

item.title: Iran warns new U.S. assault would see it expand "geography of the war"
item.description: As President Trump touts a looming decision on his next move in the war, Tehran says any "new aggression" would be met with different weapons in new places.

item.title: Firefighters struggle with staffing shortages amid record wildfire season
item.description: Wildfires have burned more than 8.5 million acres of land in the U.S. this year, and at the peak of the season, there weren't enough people or equipment to fight them.

item.title: Republican, Democratic strategists react to AI becoming an issue for midterm voters
item.description: Artificial intelligence is quickly becoming a key issue for voters participating in the midterm elections. Political strategists Kristian Ramos and Harrison Fields join with more.

item.title: Ed Sheeran says he "never wanted to be an activist musician" at first concert since Macklemore drop
item.description: Ed Sheeran performed alone at his first concert since Macklemore was dropped from the tour for his pro-Palestinian comments onstage, resulting in Sheeran's other openers leaving as well. Sheeran told fans he "never wanted to be an activist musician" amid the controversy. Vlad Duthiers has the latest.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue to restore White House access
item.description: The three news organizations, which were banned from White House grounds by President Trump, are arguing that the ban is unconstitutional.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico to sue Trump administration over White House ban
item.description: CNN, MS NOW and Politico say they're suing the Trump administration for access over their ban from the White House. Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: ICE agent shoots DoorDash driver in Austin, authorities say
item.description: Protests erupted in Austin, Texas, after officials said an ICE agent shot a DoorDash driver on Sunday. The driver is in serious but stable condition, police said.

item.title: Princess Diana's brother reveals staggering details from after her death
item.description: Princess Diana's brother, Charles Spencer, sat down with Mark Phillips for "CBS Sunday Morning" to discuss his upcoming memoir and bombshell revelation that King Charles III shrugged off Diana's death in 1997.

item.title: Eye Opener: Protests erupt in Austin after ICE shooting
item.description: Protests erupted in Austin, Texas, after authorities said an ICE agent shot and wounded a DoorDash driver. All that and all that matters in today's Eye Opener.

item.title: Massive Ukrainian drone attack in Russia
item.description: Ukraine launched a large barrage of drones into Russia, targeting Moscow over the weekend. CBS News' Aidan Stretch reports.

item.title: Italy's Meloni plans to limit foreign student numbers, ban face coverings in schools
item.description: Meloni said the government would bring the proposed legislation to the Council of Ministers, after which it would require parliamentary approval to become law.

item.title: ICE agent shoots Venezuelan man in Texas
item.description: A Venezuelan man was shot in Austin, Texas, by a U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent on Sunday, officials say. 28-year-old Wilber Rafael Garces Perez was working for DoorDash at the time of the shooting, his lawyer said. CBS News' Jason Allen reports.

item.title: Hunter fatally shoots woman he mistook for a deer, police say
item.description: A man shot and killed a woman in Delaware last week, after he mistook her for a deer, police said.

item.title: Patrick Clancy describes "massive" panic attack during Lindsay Clancy murder trial
item.description: Patrick Clancy says he suffered a "massive, traumatic" panic attack on the second day of his testimony during Lindsay Clancy's murder trial. "60 Minutes" correspondent Ross Douthat joins CBS News Mornings with more on his conversations with Clancy.

item.title: Houthis expand attacks on Saudi Arabia as Trump says he's in "deciding mode" on Iran
item.description: Houthi rebels in Yemen are expanding their attacks on Saudi Arabia, escalating tensions in the Middle East. Meanwhile, President Trump says he's in "deciding mode" for next steps in Iran. CBS News' Courtney Kealy joins with more insight.

item.title: Three major news outlets to sue Trump administration over White House ban
item.description: CNN, MS NOW and Politico say they are suing the Trump administration after being barred by the president. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi reports.

item.title: Calls for AI safety as Trump prepares to meet with China's Xi
item.description: Details on another incident involving a rogue AI agent are emerging as President Trump prepares to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington, D.C. Politico's Katherine Long joins CBS News with more details.

item.title: Patrick Clancy tells "60 Minutes" that he prayed for one of his children to live
item.description: Patrick Clancy spoke to "60 Minutes" following his ex-wife's murder trial. Dr. Heather Berlin, a neuroscientist and clinical psychologist, joins CBS News with her take on his comments.

item.title: Police officer wounded in shooting near synagogue on Yom Kippur
item.description: Police have not said what led to the shooting or whether the synagogue or Jewish community was targeted.

item.title: 10 lions found dead in suspected poisoning at wildlife reserve
item.description: An investigation is underway to establish the definitive cause of the deaths inside the area where wildlife including lions, elephants and black rhinos live.

item.title: Her son was dying, but his rare cancer made it difficult to get the right drug
item.description: As knowledge about genetics advances, some doctors say cancers should be defined by their mutations, not the tissues where they manifest.

item.title: Presley Gerber, son of Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber, dies at 27
item.description: Presley Gerber, the son of Cindy Crawford and Rande Gerber, has died at 27, a family spokesperson has confirmed.

item.title: Patrick Clancy opens up about grief, his children and moving forward
item.description: In the first interview since his ex-wife's murder trial, Patrick Clancy describes what happened at home before his children were killed and how he handled his grief in the aftermath.

item.title: Alberta to vote on whether to stay a part of Canada
item.description: The Canadian province of Alberta, a major supplier of oil and natural gas to the U.S., will vote next month on a possible referendum that could break up the country. Ian Lee reports from Raymond, Alberta.

item.title: Data center developers want to make it hard to track them: elected official
item.description: Data center construction is booming, with many more planned for rural America. But there's also growing tension between economic development and community pushback.

item.title: 9/20: CBS Weekend News
item.description: Global threats impact the U.S. economy as the midterms loom; record U.S. diesel prices squeeze farmers.

item.title: Transcript: Sen. Bill Cassidy on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan," Sept. 20, 2026
item.description: The following is the transcript of the interview with Sen. Bill Cassidy, Republican of Louisiana, that aired on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" on Sept. 20, 2026.

item.title: 9/20: Face The Nation
item.description: This week on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan," President Trump faces a pivotal week ahead in foreign policy as the House is recessed until after the midterm elections. Reps. Ro Khanna and Maria Elvira Salazar join, as well as Sen. Bill Cassidy.

item.title: U.S. embassies across Middle East issue security alerts for Americans
item.description: The alerts did not cite a specific threat, but called for Americans to "exercise heightened vigilance."
